question: Which reference points on the forehead and eye are specified for alignment?
premises: A point on the right of the forehead is specified.
A point in the middle of the left eye is specified.
The alignment is to be taken likewise.
inference: Alignment is specified at the right of the forehead and likewise at the middle of the left eye.
